scenes.headline: Halo's 2.8× over TRL is not a kernel.
scenes.sub: The baseline is tuned. The asymmetry is sharding.

scenes.label: The claim
scenes.quote: Halo delivers up to ~2.8× the training throughput of stock TRL (2.7× at 25% less peak memory when both sides shard ZeRO-3)

scenes.label: At 4k, Halo's throughput over stock TRL
4k, batch 1, tok/s/GPU on 8 B300s
scenes.note: handicapped with the worse kernel, Halo is still ahead

scenes.text: The 2.8× is a real number about a real choice; the 1.25–2.68× is the framework.

total: Not the kernel: sharding and token routing.
